result.stdout:
Rexo.Cli - repository operating system

Usage:
  Rexo.Cli <command> [args] [options]

Built-in commands:
  version                     Show tool version
  list                        List all available commands
  explain <command>           Explain a command (or alias)
  explain version             Show version provider configuration
  doctor                      Check environment and configuration
  capabilities                Show runtime capability contract and supported features
  init                        Create a starter rexo config
  new                         Alias for init
  init detect                 Preview auto detection and recommendations
  init ci                     Scaffold thin CI wrappers for rx release
      --provider              github|azdo|both (default: both)
      --yes                   Non-interactive defaults
      --stack                 auto|dotnet|node|python|go|generic
      --detect                Preview detection only (no files written)
      --dry-run               Alias for --detect
      --schema-source         remote (default) or local
      --with-policy           Also create policy.json from an embedded policy
      --policy                standard|dotnet (or any embedded policy name)
      --with-docker-artifact  Add starter docker artifact to generated config
      --without-docker-artifact  Skip docker artifact scaffolding (non-interactive)
      --with-instructions     Download rexo.instructions.md into repo
      --instructions-path     Repo-relative destination
      --force                 Overwrite existing config
  run <command>               Run a configured command
  config resolved             Show the fully-merged configuration
  config sources              Show config file sources in merge order
  config materialize          Write the merged config to a file
  policies list               List available embedded policies
  policies show <name>        Show an embedded policy
  ui                          Open the interactive UI
  help                      
[truncated]
